refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: Requires g_admin 1 and confirmed internal GUID authentication for players. C/antirush or the configured management level grants access; explicit ACL denials override legacy access. On/off persists the native switch and selects g_antirush 2 only after saving succeeds. Keep g_antirush 2 in the startup configuration. Status reports mode and remaining protection. Console antirush uses the same admin system.
